track: Prefix-Bound TRA-1 + EK5 SSD KV/Prefix Cache
primary_endpoint: Logit-equivalent KV reuse (max_abs_logit_diff < 1e-4 and identical greedy tokens versus full prefill) bound to the complete causal prefix token ids, exact positions, attention-mask hash, base and adapter weight SHA-256, config, tokenizer, KV dtype and RoPE scaling hash, with EK5 invalidation of blocks whose causal prefix contains a retracted file or commit

stale_weight_probe.scenario: weights or adapters change while config and tokenizer stay identical
stale_weight_probe.memt_reference: MemT-1.0 modeling_memt.py:876 _state_identity() omits base and adapter weights

design.retirement_note: claim registry retires the bundle when the cache performance threshold ties or is missed; the runtime reports retirement_trigger_fired separately from mechanism gates

tiers.local-drycheck: floor: synthetic git histories and a tiny deterministic numpy causal model
tiers.run-live: fail-closed: real LLM KV path and real clones not wired

evidence_disclosure.scope: Local drycheck of the SSD KV-repo cache, plus a fail-closed SSDKVCache.reload_persisted guard with negative unit tests.
evidence_disclosure.guard: reload_persisted refuses a persisted block with no weight-bound contract_digest and a literal model_weights_sha256 that mismatches the active weights; it verifies contract_digest (which binds the weights SHA) rather than requiring a literal model_weights_sha256 key, and put() is unchanged.
evidence_disclosure.synthetic: Synthetic tiny model and KV blocks.
